Entries.winter_Thu4: Blood? Oh... don't worry, @. It's not mine. I guess I forgot to wash this shirt after what I did yesterday.$h
Entries.winter_Thu8: You're missing a lot of your clothes, huh? If you ever find out who took them, tell me immediately.#$b#I'll get them back for you. ...What kind of creep steals clothes, anyway?$s#$e#...
Entries.winter_Thu10: @... hey. I've been waiting all day! What do you want to talk about this time?$h
Entries.winter_Fri2: %Sebastian is staring at you with an oddly wide smile. His gaze follows you across the room.
Entries.winter_Fri4: @... you're my only friend at this point. Please don't leave me... I couldn't live without you.$s
Entries.winter_Fri6: Since it's winter, I've been seeing you fish a lot recently. Would you mind if I came and sat next to you sometime?
Entries.winter_Fri8: I've been collecting knives recently.#$e#Weird, I know... but they're just so cool-looking. And useful...$l
Entries.winter_Sat2: Since it's winter, I guess you have more free time on your hands, right?#$e#You should come visit more often.$l
Entries.winter_Sat4: @... has anyone ever told you that you have a cute face?$l#$e#Well, if someone else did, I'd have a problem.$a
Entries.winter_Sat8: Are you looking at me...? Heh... does that mean you're interested in me, @?
Entries.winter_Sat10: I've been a lot more paranoid recently. Hmm...#$e#Watching you makes me feel better, though.
Entries.winter_Sun2: Hey, @. If you ever have any annoying guys bothering you, tell me, okay?#$e#I'll make them wish they never approached you.$a
Entries.winter_Sun4: Hey, @. Does my hair look okay?#$e#I'll keep it this way if you like it.$l
Entries.winter_Sun8: Sometimes, I get a really bad urge to touch you. So bad it almost hurts... will you let me when that happens, @?
Entries.winter_Sun10: You trust me, right? @... I'd never do anything to hurt you. Ever. All I want to do is protect you.
Entries.fall_13: Huh? Abigail's birthday? I really don't care...#$e#You're the only guy I care about, @.^You're the only girl I care about, @.
Entries.fall_27: Hahahahah...! Ahaha...! Ha... haha...$h#$e#Hahahahahahahahahahahaha! Haha! Ahaha!$h
Entries.fall_21: You look cold. Do you want my hoodie, @? I'll give it to you right now if you do.
Entries.summer_9: %Sebastian quickly puts away a shining silver object as soon as he sees you.#$e#@...! I didn't see you there... how are you? Hahaha!$h
Entries.summer_17: It's Sam's birthday today. Are you going to give him something?#$e#You don't like him, do you?$a
Entries.summer_19: You look pretty cute standing around like that, @.$l$#e#I'm so lucky...$h
Entries.winter_9: My birthday is tomorrow. Huh.#$e#I'd be really happy if you came to visit me... That's way better than getting a present or something.$l
Entries.Sun8_inlaw_Abigail: I can't believe you married Abigail... you could have chosen so much better, @. I'm disappointed.#$e#Do I mean myself? Yes... she couldn't come close to loving you as much as I do.#$b# Then again, She's always been the type to get in my way... I'll get rid of her if that's what it takes for us to be together.$h
Entries.Sun8_inlaw_Shane: Shane really is the lowest of the low. What's so special about him? As far as I can tell, he's all bad news. A liability.$a#$b#He's going to ruin your livelihood, @. Why don't you leave him for me? I'd treat you much better than him.
Entries.Tue8_inlaw_Shane: If Shane ever goes on an alcohol-induced rampage, tell me immediately and I'll come to your rescue. He'll regret even trying to hurt my sweet @...$s
Entries.Sun8_inlaw_Alex: I didn't think your taste in men was this bad, @. What makes that dumb jock more attractive than me? What is it?! He's not even smart or anything!$a#$e#Is it his appearance...? Well then, I'll be sure to ruin it so you won't love him as much anymore.
Entries.Sun8_inlaw_Elliot: Did you marry Elliot because he's romantic? You could have just told me that's what you liked, @.#$b#I would've changed up my act if it made you like me.
Entries.Tue8_inlaw_Elliot: Maybe I should set fire to Elliot's  little old cabin on the beach, and then blame it on you.#$e#After all, if he hates you, you have nobody else to turn to except for me.
Entries.Sun8_inlaw_Sam: ...You've chosen to marry Sam? I don't get it. What makes him so much better than me?!$a#$b#He doesn't deserve you! I'll kill him!$a
Entries.Tue8_inlaw_Sam: I still can't believe that you married Sam... especially after I've spent so long telling him to stay away from you.$s#$b#It's getting unbearable... I'll have to do something about it soon.$s#$e#...No, I'm not telling you what.
Entries.Sun8_inlaw_Harvey: You've chosen to marry the town's doctor, huh? Haha... I know we need a doctor, but everyone in pelican town might just have to go without him from now on.
Entries.Tue8_inlaw_Harvey: Harvey is so boring. Why not ditch him for me, @? I'll make you so much happier... promise. I already know you'd really prefer to be with me.$l

Entries.give_flowersA: ...You... you want me to be your boyfriend? Haha... aha...! Of course I'll accept, @...!$l#$b#I love you so much! I knew you felt the same... Now you're all mine!$h#$b#I'll never let you go...$l
Entries.give_flowersB: @... wow, I... you really want to date a crazy guy like me?$h#$b#Well, I could never refuse you, so the answer is obviously yes...$l#$b#I'll be the best boyfriend that I can possibly be for you. In exchange, you're not allowed to leave me.$l
Entries.give_pendant: ...You... you're asking if I'll marry you? Really? Am I dreaming...? I've been waiting for this day for so long! Yes, @...#$b# The thought of having you as my husband is almost too good to be true. Give me about 3 days, and everything will be ready for our wedding.^The thought of having you as my wife is almost too good to be true. Give me about 3 days, and I'll get everything ready for our wedding...$l
Entries.stardrop_gift: @... you're my world. You make me happier than any guy on the planet. So... I found this, and I thought you should have it.$h#$b#Take it as my gratitude for giving someone crazy like me a chance with you... I love you, @.
Entries.reject_two_heartA: As much as I want to say yes, I'll have to hold off on that for now... sorry, @.$s#$b#I really do want to accept it...$s
Entries.reject_two_heartB: Hah... you want me to be your boyfriend already, huh? As much as I like you, let's get to know each other better first.$s
Entries.reject_four_heartA: Oh wow, @. I didn't take you for the hasty type. I'm flattered, but...$h#$b#I'll have to say no for now. I need to take care of a few things first.$s
Entries.reject_four_heartB: @... I can't. Sorry... I feel really bad right now... give me some space, okay?...$s
Entries.engageA: ...You're a horrible person, @. You've got to be joking...$a#$e#Well? If you're serious, then I guess I'll have to kill your precious fiance. That's what you wanted, right?$a
Entries.engageB: Aha...You're just asking for it now. Playing with my feelings...#$b#...but, because I love you, I'll give you some mercy. It's your fiance that's in trouble.$a
Entries.marriedA: ...? Huh? Haha... I guess you listened when I told you that you'd be better off with me. Just be sure to divorce %spouse first.
Entries.marriedB: Heh... you suddenly find me more enticing than your precious %spouse now? I'm happy, but... I'll only accept if you break it off with them first. I want you all to myself.
Entries.refusal_no_heartsA: Ah... why are you doing this? I don't understand...
Entries.refusal_no_heartsB: @... I like you, but I'm not in the right headspace to accept this yet. Maybe later. I promise I'll be ready by then.
Entries.refusal_knownA: @... I can't just yet. Sorry. Please wait for me. There's some things I have to to do first.$h
Entries.refusal_knownB: %Sebastian stares at the bouquet longingly, but he doesn't say a word.
Entries.refusal_botherA: @... I told you earlier that I want you to stay away from me for a while. I don't want to accidentally hurt you, or... something.$s
Entries.refusal_botherB: I'm sorry, but... what I said before still applies. Please stay away... for now.$s

Entries.spring_6: Hello, @! Keep this between you and me, but I think my son Sebastian has a crush on you. All he does is talk about you, that boy! He hasn't stopped since you've moved here!$h
Entries.spring_20: Hey, @! When I was passing through your farm earlier, I saw some flowers at your windowsill. Did Sebastian givethose to you?$h#$b#I saw him picking those very flowers in the mountains one afternoon, mumbling to himself. He looked so happy.
Entries.summer_14: Sebastian has been returning at night later and later these past few weeks. Sometimes he won't even come home until around 3 am...#$e#I wonder what could be so important to him all of a sudden? He never used to go out this much.#$b#Wait, @... are you and him meeting up in secret or something? What? Considering how much he talks about you, it's natural to assume, right? Haha! He always tells me it's 'important business'...$h
Entries.summer_18: Sebastian always looks like he's in a daze whenever I see him. I almost can't describe it... he looks spaced out, but, happy at the same time, so I don't question it...$s
Entries.fall_4: Sebastian got angrier than usual when I tried to go into his room the other day... he wouldn't even let me through the door. It makes me wonder if there's something he doesn't want me to see... normally, he doesn't mind. Not that much, anyway...
Entries.fall_13: Oh, Yoba... hi, @. I didn't see you there.#$e#What? I'm alright... today's just been exhausting. Earlier, Sebastian lashed out at Sam like nothing I've ever seen before, just because he mentioned you. Sam ended up leaving his room in tears... I'm worried about the both of them.$s
Entries.winter_10: I hear Sebastian talking a lot while I'm in the house... the weird thing is, nobody else is ever over in his room.#$b#At first I thought it was some online chatting program, but I always hear him saying your name.
Entries.winter_24: Earlier, Sebastian asked me what kind of gifts you liked! I guess he wanted to get you a present for the upcoming Feast of the Winter Star, huh? He really adores you, @!$h

Entries.spring_13: Last night, I heard someone laughing to themselves at the beach.#$e#I have no idea who it was, and it was kinda creepy...#$e#But, it reminded me of Seb's 'evil laugh' that he used for all of the villains when we play Solarian Chronicles.#$e#Maybe it was him? That's not like him, though. Still, more funny than scary now that I think about it. Oh! Maybe he was practicing?$h
Entries.spring_23: Seb's not wanted to hang out lately... he's acting weird.$s#$e#Says he's 'busy' all the time. I wonder what he's doing? I mean... sometimes, I go to hang out at his house and he's not even there. He's just... gone.$s#$e#
Entries.summer_16: So, you know how Seb keeps tellin' me he's busy all the time? Last night, I saw him in town. It was pitch black, so I couldn't really tell, but... I recognized his voice. I think he was talking to someone?$s#$e#Or, maybe he was talking to himself... I couldn't hear anyone else.#$e#Naturally, I went over since I've been worried about him lately...#$b#but he just yelled at me and told me to get lost... I think I scared him at first, because he freaked out, like, big time.$s#$e#...What's happening to my friend, @?$s
Entries.summer_18: Seb's ignoring my messages. He's not been showing up to band practice, either...$s#$e#Maybe his home life's gotten worse to the point of not wanting to talk to anyone?#$e#He still talks to you, you say? Huh...$s
Entries.fall_5: A-ah... @. Oh Yoba, @... did you hear?$s#$e#A ton of guys in the neighborhood woke up to dead animals in their mailboxes. Including me...#$e#The stench... *gag* I feel sick just thinking about it. The poor animals, too... who did this?$s
Entries.fall_20: ...!$s#$e#Oh, it's you, @. Sorry... I'm a little jumpy today.#$e#Why...? Well, uh...last  night... I saw Sebastian.$s#$e#He looked so angry... next thing I knew, we were outside of the Saloon, and he had my shirt in his fist...$s#$e#He went on about how, if I told on him, I'd be in real big trouble. Then, he told me to 'stay away from @', or else I'd be in trouble for that, too.#$e#Why am I telling you this...? I don't know. He's getting violent and... I guess I'm scared for you.$s
Entries.winter_4: @... I really, really don't think I should be talking to you anymore.$s#$e#Yesterday, Seb started chasing me like a maniac, knife in hand, shouting and everything...#$e#He was really fast. Eventually, he got to me. I tried fighting back, but it was pretty useless since he had a knife.$s#$e#He was all like, 'I told you to stay away from @'. His eyes were so messed up, too...$s#$e#Told me it was my final warning, or I was done for. So... @. I'm gonna have to stop talking to you now. I value my life too much... I'm sorry.#$e#From now on, I won't tell you any more about this... I'll just try to act normal... See you.$s
Entries.winter_10: I told you... Please don't talk to me anymore. If Seb sees us, he's gonna kill me...

Entries.Sebastian: Would winning make you happy, @? If you want, I can set things up so that the other contestants'll trip.#$b#That way, you can take all of the eggs! Pretty nice idea, right?#$e#Either way, I'll be watching you.$l
I should throw the rotten eggs at Sam later, when he won't expect it.#$e#Oh come on, just because I'm dating you doesn't mean I don't still get jealous... or cautious when you're around other guys.$s
You're so cute, getting all excited... mind if I follow you around for a bit? I don't want anyone else getting close to you.$h

Did you come to ask me to dance with you? It's pretty embarrassing, but if you need a partner... Of course. I'd do anything for you.$l#$e#...Nobody else is allowed to dance with you, anyway. I won't let anyone touch you.$a
Hey. Wanna dance with me? I want to show everyone that you're mine.$l#$e#...$l
Ahahaha, now nobody else can dance with you except me! Since we're married and all...$h#$e#Hm... though, seeing you dressed up like this and knowing that you're mine is... satisfying.
Maybe I should poison the soup... that way, I wouldn't have to worry about competition.$h#$e#Huh? ...I'm just joking around, @. Or am I?$l
I put something extra special in the soup. Just for you, @. I love you... I hope you like it.$l#$e#...$l
Oh, hey babe. Can we go home yet? The sun is really bothering me... and the other guys around you, too. It's making me anxious.
I should push Sam into the water!$h#$e#Then he won't be in my way anymore.$l#$e#What...? That's a terrible idea...? Fine.$a
It's pretty dark, so you should stay close to me. Is it alright if I hold you?
Hey, while everyone is distracted by the lights in the water, wanna make out? $h#$e#Aw...promise me you will when we get home, then?$s
I went to see that fortune teller, just out of curiosity... and she said that our futures are bound together. Isn't that great? I hope it comes true.$h
Do you need help winning any of the games, @? I'll do anything you ask. If you want, I can bribe or threaten the people running the stands!$h
Hey, what's up? I'm just keeping an eye on Sam.#$e#Don't go too far from me, okay? There's a lot of strangers here.
Don't worry, @. If you get too scared, just call me and I'll come running.

Hey, @. Want to go into the maze together? I'll protect you from anything that's in there!$h#$e#I even brought a knife, so you'll be completely safe with me.$h#$e#...I can use it on the other guys too, if you want. Heh.$l
I've packed together some super-hard snowballs, to throw at Sam. Wanna join me, @?$h
It's cold out, @. Are you wearing warm enough clothes?$s#$e#Come here... I'll keep you warm myself.$l
...Mm.$h#$e#What? You don't like when I kiss you in public? Your red nose is cute, so I just had to. Oh, and to show everyone that you're only interested in me, obviously...$h

Hi, @. If you're wondering if I got some gifts for you, you're right. I left them under the tree in your house. $h#$e#Oh, and by the way, you don't have to get me anything. You're the most precious gift to me.$l
I'm thankful for you, @. I love you so much...$l#$e#...You should come over later tonight. Then I can show you just how much I love you.$l
Hey, remember when we were dating and we spent the whole night together getting wasted? Good times.$h#$e#Do you remember what exactly we did that night? If you want, I wouldn't mind a reenactment.$l

Entries.spring_19: It feels like Sebastian has completely cut contact with me... He hasn't talked to me in weeks.$s#$e#I saw him a little while ago, but he just ignored me and kept walking... mumbling to himself. I heard him say your name...$s
Entries.spring_25: @! Did you know? I saw Sebastian outside your house the other night...$s#$e#Are you guys dating or something? It was late! It was kind of funny to watch, though.$h
Entries.summer_4: Earlier, when I was playing my flute... in the mountains, I saw a ton of cigarette butts and empty packs on the ground. Like... way more than I've ever seen before.$s#$e#I know Sebastian smokes, but... it was a lot. I hope he's okay...$s
Entries.summer_20: Sebastian was talking to me about his knife collection earlier...$s#$e#Don't get me wrong, I like knives and stuff... but he's never really had an interest in this stuff before. It was kind of weird.$s
Entries.fall_7: Sebastian has been leaving Sam and I completely in the dark lately. He doesn't want to hang out, and we almost never see him around... We did once, but it was in a weird place.$s#$e#Where? Not to scare you, but... I think he was following you.#$b#When we told him you were going into the mines later, we saw him at the entrance behind some bush with a knife. It kind of freaked me out...$s#$e#...Maybe he wanted to kill some monsters. I dunno.
Entries.winter_10: Hey, @. Sebastian told Sam and I today that he wouldn't be coming to a party that we're throwing for the Feast of the Winter Star.$s#$e#He said he 'didn't want to make you jealous'. What is up with him?$a

Entries.summer_3: @! You won't believe what happened today!#$e#Earlier, Sebastian came by and asked to borrow one of my cameras! I wonder what he wants to use it for? He's never showed any interest in photography before...
Entries.summer_15: Hey, @. I should probably tell you something...$s#$e#Earlier when I saw Sebastian, he dropped this... picture when he left.$s#$e#It was a picture of you... and it was kinda strange. Like a candid shot? Trust me, I know.$s#$e#But yeah... next thing I knew, he called me, begging for the picture back. I've never heard him sound so desperate before.#$e#It's really weird, right? He was so scary about it! Why is he keeping pictures of you like some kind of creep, anyway?!$a
Entries.fall_20: Hi, @. Have you been alright since the picture incident with Sebastian? If you need anything, let me know. Girls have to stick together when it comes to stuff like this.$s

Entries.spring_15: Last night, I saw Sebastian running around town. Disappared afterwards when he went in the direction of your farm.#$e#It was kinda funny. That guy's pretty fast...
Entries.summer_5: Sebastian was glaring at me earlier... I have no idea why. I haven't even done anything to the guy!$a
Entries.summer_12: ...$s#$e#*whisper* psst, @. Can I ask you something?$s#$e#Next time you see Sebastian, can you tell him that there's nothing going on between us? He threatened me earlier, told me not to talk to you ever again.$s#$e#He was holding a knife, too... So please, don't talk to me anymore. I don't want to have my body dumped into the river just because he saw me with you.$s
Entries.fall_5: That emo kid, Sebastian... he was always weird, but he's just downright scary now.$s#$e# Every time I look at him, he's glaring at me, spinning this knife in his hand. What's his problem?$a#$e#Either way, something's definitely wrong with him.$a

Entries.spring_3: Hey, @! Earlier, Sebastian asked me what kind of stuff you liked! It was kind of out of character for him, and I said I didn't know, but I found it so sweet!$h#$b#Hey, if you end up dating my brother, take good care of him, okay?$h
Entries.spring_20: All my half-brother ever talks about is you, @!$h#$e#It's kind of adorable... He used to never talk to me before, but the second I mentioned you the other day, he went on a big tangent about you!#$b#By the time he was done talking, I realized I was late for work! Haha, don't worry! They were all positive things!$h
Entries.summer_3: My half-brother isn't the same anymore.$s#$e#He's even more reclusive than before. He yells at anyone who enters his room, locks his door all the time... and sometimes I hear him laughing to himself. He talks to himself, too... and it's always about you.$s
Entries.summer_14: Sebastian never leaves his room anymore. He looks so sickly, too... even though he always has a happy look on his face.$s#$e#It's worrying me. Maybe I should make him come in for a checkup at the clinic?
Entries.fall_2: @! I have to tell you something!$s#$e#When Sebastian left earlier, I snooped around his room because I was worried about him, and...$s#$e#Oh Yoba, @... There were pictures of you all over his wall! I'm talking, the wall was COMPLETELY covered. ...My brother is absolutely obsessed with you...$s
Entries.fall_13: My brother keeps keeping me up at night... I'm scared.$s#$b#Last night, I heard him just... cackling to himself outside, along with the screams of some sort of animal... I think it was a cat?#$e#...@. I'm so scared... he wasn't like this until you moved here. He was different back then.
